_tooltips.code: Key the value is stored under, unique within the entity type, e.g. orderNumber. Avoid changing it once records exist.
_tooltips.name: The field's label as users see it on forms and list columns, e.g. Order number.
_tooltips.valueKind: What kind of value the field holds: text, number, yes/no, date, date and time, a choice from a list (ENUM) or a reference to another record. Decides how values are checked and compared.
_tooltips.formControlType: Which input users fill the field in with, e.g. TEXT_BOX, TEXTAREA, DROPDOWN or CHECKBOX. Pick one that suits the value kind.
_tooltips.displayOrder: Position of the field on the form and of its column in the list; lower numbers come first, e.g. 10, 20, 30.
_tooltips.multiplicity: How many values the field takes: 0..1 at most one, 0..n / 1..n any number (at least one with 1..), 0..x / 1..x up to Max occurs. Leave empty for a single value.
_tooltips.maxOccurs: Upper limit on the number of values, e.g. 5. Only used with the multiplicities 0..x and 1..x.
_tooltips.required: Whether users must fill the field in before they can save the record.
_tooltips.indexed: Tick for fields users often search or filter on, e.g. a customer number; it makes those queries fast.
_tooltips.isLinkToDetails: Tick for the field that names the record, e.g. the order number: it opens the record from the list and heads its form. At most one field per entity type.
_tooltips.autosizeColumn: Tick to make the field's list column only as wide as its content, e.g. for short codes or flags.
_tooltips.enumValues: For the ENUM value kind: the options users choose from, one chip each, e.g. NEW, PAID, SHIPPED.
_tooltips.linkedEntityType: For reference fields (FOREIGN_KEY) and embedded rows (EMBEDDED_COMPONENTS): the code of the entity type they point at, e.g. customer.
_tooltips.defaultValue: Value pre-filled in new records, e.g. NEW or 1. Leave empty for none.
_tooltips.defaultAvatar: For AVATAR controls: icon name (e.g. person, sailing) or image URL to show before an image is uploaded.
_tooltips.showMap: For ADDRESS controls: show the address on a map, with coordinates derived from it.
_tooltips.mapProvider: For ADDRESS controls with a map: who draws it. Empty uses OpenStreetMap; a click always opens Google Maps.
_tooltips.defaultCountry: For ADDRESS controls: the ISO country code a new address starts with, e.g. HU. Empty uses the browser's country.
_tooltips.dateStyle: For DATE and DATE_TIME fields: how the date is shown, from short (12/31/26) to full (Thursday, December 31, 2026). Empty uses the default.
_tooltips.timeStyle: For DATE_TIME fields: how the time is shown, from short (14:30) to long (with seconds and time zone). Empty uses the default.

_tooltips.code: Unique key of the entity type within your organization, used in addresses. Short, lower-case and URL-safe, e.g. order; avoid changing it later.
_tooltips.name: The entity name the application's pages, routes and menus refer to this type by, e.g. Order.
_tooltips.description: A note for you and your fellow designers about what this entity type is for; users do not see it.
_tooltips.status: ACTIVE for a type in use, DEPRECATED to retire it: the application no longer shows a deprecated type. Whether the application has the type at all is its release, shown under Release.
_tooltips.isEmbedded: Tick when records of this type exist only inside another record, e.g. order lines inside an order. Then also name the parent under Component Parents.
_tooltips.componentParents: For an embedded type: the codes of the entity types whose records contain it, e.g. order. Required when Embedded is ticked.
_tooltips.attributes: The fields of the entity type, one row per field. They are saved together with the definition.
_tooltips.version: Increases with every save. Set by the system.
_tooltips.updatedAt: When the definition was last saved. Set by the system.
_tooltips.releaseState: Whether the running application uses this definition as it stands: NEW was never published, CHANGED differs from what was published, RELEASED is what the application uses. Publish in the Release section to change it. Set by the system.
